info.title: PALTAS API
info.description: Generated from backend/contracts — do not edit by hand. Money is in integer minor units with a currency. Errors are { error: { code, message, details? } }.

get.summary: Is the server up and does its database answer (503 otherwise); which billing mode it uses. Render polls this.

post.summary: Sign in. PALTAS staff and anyone with two-factor turned on must also send the 6-digit code.
End this session

get.summary: The signed-in person, the organisations they belong to, and invitations waiting for an answer

post.summary: Accept an invitation to join an organisation
Decline an invitation; the organisation keeps no membership
Change your password. Every other session of yours is signed out.
Start turning on two-factor sign-in: returns a secret for an authenticator app (shown once)
Finish turning on two-factor sign-in with a code from the authenticator app

Ask for a password reset link by e-mail. The answer is the same whether or not the address has an account; the link (single use, short-lived) goes through the e-mail outbox. Limited per address and per e-mail.
Set a new password with the token from the reset link (works once, expires); every session is signed out

get.summary: The organisation's profile and its products
People in the organisation and their roles

post.summary: Add a person with a role. A new account gets a temporary password, returned ONCE, to pass on through a secure channel. An existing PALTAS account is invited instead and has no access until that person accepts.

put.summary: Change a person's role or suspend them. You cannot change your own access.

get.summary: The organisation's audit trail, newest first. Entries can never be changed or deleted.
Which modules this product subscription may use right now
Plan, modules, allowance, scheduled changes, the monthly charge, invoices and receipts
Every sellable product: subscribed or not, and the plans on offer

post.summary: Add another product as a separate subscription (trial, or awaiting payment of the first invoice)
Order an add-on module. It starts only when the payment is confirmed by the provider.

delete.summary: Cancel an add-on from the next billing date. Its records stay readable.

post.summary: Upgrade (after payment) or schedule a downgrade for the next billing date. The plan decides the product.
Order one extra building or project allowance
Cancel this product subscription at the end of the paid period. Records are kept, read-only afterwards.

delete.summary: Withdraw a scheduled change before it takes effect

post.summary: Ask PALTAS for an Enterprise package

get.summary: Plans this product subscription can move to, from the catalogue, with price, billing period and trial state

post.summary: Choose a plan and billing period for a trial or lapsed subscription: an invoice is issued, and the subscription becomes active ONLY when that invoice is paid (signed provider event, or a bank transfer confirmed by PALTAS staff)

get.summary: Every record of your organisation as one JSON document, streamed — also after a trial has expired (records are kept). Organisation administrator only; audited with the reason.

post.summary: Create or resume a Stripe-hosted recurring subscription checkout for an unpaid PALTAS plan invoice
Open the owning organisation's dedicated Stripe billing portal; no payment or cancellation is executed by this request
Receive Stripe snapshot events; raw-body Stripe signature required, replay-safe processing
Receive a signed payment event from a provider adapter

get.summary: The chart of accounts with balances

post.summary: Add an account. The first digit must match its type (1 asset, 2 liability, 3 equity, 4 income, 5–9 expense).

put.summary: Rename an account, or deactivate it once its balance is zero

get.summary: Posted movements on one account between two dates, with opening and running balance
Journals, newest first, optionally filtered

post.summary: Prepare a manual journal. It must balance, and someone else must approve it before it posts.

get.summary: One journal with its lines

post.summary: Approve and post a journal prepared by someone else
Reject a journal awaiting approval, with a reason
Prepare the reversal of a posted journal (mirror lines). It needs approval like any manual journal.

get.summary: Debit and credit balance of every account from posted journals up to a date
Months that have been closed or reopened (any other month is open)

post.summary: Close a month: nothing can post into it until it is reopened
Reopen a closed month, with a reason kept in the audit log

get.summary: PALTAS-only campaign review and scheduled handoff queue; publishing is not connected

post.summary: Create a server-saved PALTAS social campaign draft

put.summary: Edit a campaign with version checking; editing clears previous approval and scheduling

post.summary: Submit, independently approve, schedule a handoff or cancel; never publishes to a provider

get.summary: Every module and plan, with prices as PALTAS configured them

put.summary: Create or change a plan. Issued invoices are never rewritten; changes apply to new invoices.
Change a module's dependencies, exclusions, price, availability or scope

get.summary: Every customer organisation with its subscriptions

post.summary: Create a customer organisation, its first product subscription and its administrator
Change the status of ONE product subscription, with a reason. Other products are not affected.
Give an organisation another product subscription
Issue the subscription invoice for the next period (once per period)
Record a payment received outside a provider (bank transfer), with the bank reference and a reason

get.summary: The platform audit trail, newest first
The platform trial policy every product follows, with every earlier version

put.summary: Change the platform trial policy (Super Admin, audited, kept as a new version). New trials of every product follow it at once; a trial already running keeps the days and grace it started with.

get.summary: Self-service sign-up requests (e.g. those blocked as a repeat trial, waiting for a decision)

post.summary: Override a repeat-trial block with a reason: the organisation, administrator (the password they chose) and the trial are created now, under the current policy
Decline a sign-up blocked as a repeat trial, with a reason (the chosen password is discarded)

get.summary: Self-service upgrades and how the customer chose to pay. A bank transfer is confirmed with POST /api/v1/admin/invoices/:invoiceId/receipts (bank reference and reason) or a confirmed bank statement line.
One organisation with its members, terms and every product subscription as the rules resolve it today

put.summary: Change an organisation's details, or make someone its administrator. The currency is fixed once an invoice exists.
Move ONE product subscription to another plan of the same product, now. A scheduled plan change is dropped.
Set the trial end date of one product subscription that is on trial
Negotiated terms for the whole organisation: a discount on subscription and add-on prices, and a note
Buildings (or projects) for one product subscription: additional ones, and an override of the plan's own
Switch one module on or off for one product subscription. Dependencies are checked; records are never deleted.

get.summary: Subscription invoices across organisations, newest first

post.summary: Void an unpaid invoice. It stays in the history marked Void; a paid invoice cannot be voided.

get.summary: The PALTAS team: every staff account with its role, and what each role may change

post.summary: Add a PALTAS staff member with a role (Super Admin only). Returns a temporary password and an authenticator secret ONCE; the person must change the password at first sign-in and always signs in with a 6-digit code.

put.summary: Change a staff member's role, or deactivate / reactivate the account (Super Admin only). Their open sessions end. Nobody changes their own account here, and the last active Super Admin cannot be removed.

post.summary: A lost phone or password: issue a new temporary password and a new authenticator secret (Super Admin only), returned ONCE. The old ones stop working and every open session ends.

get.summary: The client company directory: search and filter by product, status, country and how they registered
Find a client account by name or e-mail, with every company it belongs to (PALTAS staff are not listed)
The whole platform at a glance: clients, people, money and every queue waiting for a PALTAS decision
Every client conversation: waiting for a person first, then the newest
One conversation in full, internal notes included (marks the client's messages as read by PALTAS)

put.summary: Assign (userId of a staff member who may reply, or null), close or reopen, or hand the conversation back to the PALTAS assistant (needsHuman: false).

post.summary: Reply to the client as yourself (they see your name, and get an e-mail that PALTAS replied), or add an internal note for the team. A reply takes the conversation off the 'needs a person' list and assigns it to you if nobody has it.

get.summary: Domains this organisation can migrate into, with their entities, fields and duplicate keys
Source-system profiles: the built-in ones and those saved by this organisation

post.summary: Save (create or replace by name) this organisation's own source-system profile
Start a migration: choose the target domain, the source system and the cut-over date

get.summary: Migration jobs, newest first
A job with its stage, counts and import progress (poll this while it imports)

post.summary: Announce a file (name, size, SHA-256). Then send it in chunks of at most chunkBytes, and complete it. Large files never travel in one request.

get.summary: Every uploaded and extracted file, including refused ones and why

put.summary: Send one chunk (base64). Sending the same chunk again replaces it, so an interrupted upload resumes.

post.summary: Check the file (size, SHA-256, type by its magic bytes, archive safety) and keep it — or refuse it with the reason. ZIP contents are unpacked into files of their own.
Read every data file: sheets and tables, columns, a guessed entity per table, a proposed column mapping and sample rows. Documents are listed for linking.

get.summary: Detected tables with their entity and mapping

put.summary: Confirm a table's entity and column mapping (with transforms), or ignore the table with a reason

post.summary: Check every row: required fields, formats, relationships, duplicates, conflicts and balances. Errors block the import until resolved.

get.summary: Problems found by the last validation
Rows with their mapped values, decisions and issues

post.summary: Resolve a row: correct values, skip it (with a reason), merge it into another row or an existing record, keep a flagged duplicate, or undo a decision. The job is validated again.

get.summary: Documents found in the upload, how each is linked, and the review queue

post.summary: Link a document to one record, keep it unlinked, or exclude it (with a reason)
Run the whole import inside a transaction that is rolled back: what would be created, what already exists, money totals and the ledger postings. Nothing is written.
Approve the dry run for import. The person who ran the dry run cannot approve it.
Queue the approved import. A server worker runs it in batches (resumable after a restart); poll the job for progress.
Queue the failed batches again (after fixing what made them fail)

get.summary: The import batches and their state

post.summary: Undo one batch: delete only the records it created (never records that existed before) and reverse its ledger posting. Later batches must be rolled back first.
Compare source and PALTAS again: counts per entity, money totals, relationships and the ledger
Sign off a reconciled migration: PALTAS becomes the system of record and batches can no longer be undone

get.summary: Download the migration report (counts, totals, reconciliation, batches) or the exception file (every refused, skipped, merged or flagged row and document)
Records this job created in PALTAS, by entity
Who did what in this migration, oldest first
The organisation's hotels you can work in, and whether group (chain) views apply

post.summary: Add a hotel. Its currency is the organisation's; its business date starts today unless given.

get.summary: One hotel with its tax engine, business date and settings

put.summary: Change a hotel's settings (taxes, times, concierge answers, departmental account mapping)

get.summary: The members assigned to work at this hotel

put.summary: The members who work at this hotel. A member assigned to any hotel sees only the hotels they are assigned to.

get.summary: Room types, rooms, rate plans, restrictions, channels and outlets of a hotel

post.summary: Add a room type
Add physical rooms, each linked to its room type. Inventory grows with them.
Add a rate plan: BAR, a plan derived from a parent (e.g. -10%), non-refundable, breakfast, corporate …

put.summary: Change a rate plan's prices, policy or status (revenue and front-office managers only)
Replace a rate plan's seasons and day-of-week prices
Replace the hotel's restrictions: minimum / maximum stay, closed to arrival or departure, stop-sell

post.summary: Connect a sales channel (OTA, short-let platform) through the channel manager, with its commission
Add a revenue outlet (restaurant, bar, spa …) and the outlet staff who may post from it

get.summary: Company and travel-agent accounts with city-ledger balance and ageing

post.summary: Add a company or travel-agent account with its credit limit

get.summary: City-ledger statement: invoices from checked-out folios and payments received

post.summary: Record a payment received from a company (recorded, not processed). Posts bank 1000 / city ledger 1160.

get.summary: Find guest profiles by name, email, phone or ID number (returning guests are recognised at booking)

put.summary: Update a guest's preferences, VIP status, notes and consents. Allergies need the guest's consent.

get.summary: The ONE availability record by room type and night, with rates — as the booking engine or a channel sees it

post.summary: Book one or more rooms. Each night is taken from the one inventory; the last room can never be sold twice.

get.summary: Reservations staying between two dates (arrivals, in-house, departures)
One reservation with its stays, nights and deposits

post.summary: Cancel: the rooms return to sale and the rate plan's cancellation fee is charged where the policy says
Record a no-show on or after the arrival date: fee per policy, deposit applied, rooms released
Confirm a waitlisted reservation once rooms are free (takes them from inventory, or refuses)
Hold a block of rooms for a group (wedding, tour, conference) until its cut-off date

get.summary: Group blocks with rooms held and picked up per night

post.summary: Return unsold rooms of blocks whose cut-off date has passed to general sale (the night audit does this too)
Digital pre-check-in: ID captured (document reference), registration signed (signature reference), deposit recorded as a liability
Pre-assign a room of the booked type to a stay (a room never holds two overlapping stays)
Check in: room assigned (ready rooms only), folio opened, deposits applied, mobile key issued
Move an in-house guest to another ready room of the same type; the old room goes dirty, keys are re-issued
Extend a stay: the extra nights come from the one inventory and the room must stay free
Check out: every folio must balance, or a company folio goes to the city ledger (within the credit limit). Room set dirty; keys revoked.

get.summary: Guest requests, wake-up calls and concierge hand-overs

post.summary: Record a guest request or wake-up call as a task
Mark a request done

get.summary: Folios of a hotel, optionally of one reservation or stay

post.summary: Open another folio for a stay (split billing), e.g. a company folio for room and tax

get.summary: One folio with every line and its balance

put.summary: Route charges by department to a folio of the stay (e.g. rooms to the company, extras to the guest)

post.summary: Post a charge with the hotel's taxes (VAT, service charge, levy) — and to the ledger
Move charges to another open folio of the same reservation or group
Record a payment taken through the hotel's own provider or till (never processed here). Cash needs your open cashier shift.
Block a folio from room charges (outlets then require payment on the spot), or unblock it
Void a charge (reverses its ledger posting). Unapproved voids are flagged by the income audit.
Approve a void made by someone else
Request a refund of a folio credit; someone else must approve it before it posts

get.summary: Refunds of this hotel, newest first; status=requested lists those waiting for someone to approve them

post.summary: Approve a refund requested by someone else; it is recorded on the folio and posted (paid out by the hotel)
Charge an outlet sale to a room: only for a guest in house whose folio is not blocked (blocked folios pay on the spot)

get.summary: Every room's live status, with the housekeeping board figures

post.summary: Attendants start and finish their own rooms; supervisors inspect, which releases the room to the front desk
Assign rooms to an attendant for the business date
Record minibar consumption in an occupied room; it posts to the guest folio as food and beverage

get.summary: Maintenance tickets (corrective and preventive)

post.summary: Open a ticket; a room set out of order leaves inventory for those nights (refused if that would oversell)
Resolve a ticket: the room returns to service (dirty, so housekeeping prepares it)

get.summary: Lost and found register

post.summary: Record a found item
Record that the guest was contacted, or that the item was returned or disposed of

get.summary: Cashier shifts with takings by method and over / short

post.summary: Open your cashier shift with the opening float (one open shift per person)
Close your shift with the counted cash; over / short is calculated and kept

get.summary: What would block tonight's audit, and the arrivals that would become no-shows

post.summary: Close the business day: refused with the reasons while anything blocks it; otherwise posts room and tax, processes no-shows, releases group cut-offs, stores the daily report and rolls the business date

get.summary: The daily report the night audit stored for a business date
Income audit of a closed day: rates below the rate plan and voids without approval

post.summary: Sign off a closed day (income auditor; not the person who ran the night audit). Open findings must be acknowledged.

get.summary: Occupancy, ADR, RevPAR, TRevPAR, GOPPAR and cost per occupied room, from the ledger postings
Daily flash: revenue by department, occupancy, ADR, RevPAR, cash taken and deposits
Departmental P&L (USALI-style, by the hotel's account mapping): departments, undistributed, GOP, GOPPAR
Room revenue, commission and net revenue per channel (direct included)

post.summary: Post a departmental cost (rooms, F&B cost of sales, commissions, undistributed) to the ledger for this hotel

get.summary: Central reservations: rooms free for every night of a stay, across all the group's hotels
Consolidated KPIs and the owner / management-fee report per hotel
Which external systems are connected. Without a certified adapter each one is a labelled test adapter.
Availability updates queued for the channel manager (nothing is transmitted without a connected adapter)

post.summary: A booking from a channel manager (signed). It takes the room from the one inventory at once; a repeat delivery is ignored.

get.summary: Mobile keys issued for a stay

post.summary: Ask the lock adapter whether a key opens a room on a date (test adapter until a lock system is connected)
Energy rules for the business date: eco mode for vacant rooms with no arrival, welcome temperature for assigned arrivals

get.summary: Commands recorded for the room-control system

post.summary: Rule-based concierge: answers from the hotel's own FAQ, otherwise hands over to staff as a task (no external AI)

get.summary: Guest messages recorded for a hotel (or one reservation)

post.summary: Record a message to a guest. It is recorded, not sent, until a messaging provider is connected.

get.summary: Automation, finance and invoice settings of a hotel

put.summary: Change automation (automatic night audit time, pre-arrival days), finance and invoice settings

get.summary: Booking-engine promo codes

post.summary: Add a promo code: a percentage off the nightly rate, for stay dates, plans and a number of uses

put.summary: Switch a promo code on or off, or change its description or use limit

get.summary: Extras offered with a booking (breakfast, airport transfer, late check-out …)

post.summary: Add or change an extra by its code (priced per stay, per night or per adult per night)

get.summary: Room features sold for a price per night (attribute-based selling) and how many rooms have each

put.summary: Replace the prices of room features (the attribute must match the rooms' attributes, e.g. sea_view)

post.summary: Price a direct booking: nightly rates, a promo code or member rate, room features and extras

Direct booking (website / booking engine): takes the rooms from the one inventory, applies the promo code or member rate, holds a room with the chosen features and books the extras. A confirmation is recorded (not sent).

get.summary: The organisation's own loyalty programme (points, tiers, member rates); null until set up

put.summary: Set up or change the programme. The point value cannot change while points are outstanding.

get.summary: Loyalty members with points, tier and stays

post.summary: Enrol a guest profile in the programme (entry tier)

get.summary: One member with every points movement

post.summary: Redeem points against a booking: the points are taken now and credited on the guest folio (at check-in, or at once if the guest is in house). Posts loyalty liability 2400 → guest ledger 1150.
Correct a member's points (approvers only; reason kept). Posts the liability change at the point value.
Record a guest's post-stay survey (one per reservation). A score of 1–2 alerts the manager.

get.summary: Guest feedback recorded for a hotel
Guest satisfaction and review trends: average score by month and category, low scores, recurring words (rule-based, no AI)
Message templates per language ({guest}, {hotel}, {number}, {arrival}, {departure} … are filled in)

put.summary: Write the hotel's own wording of a message in a language

post.summary: Record what is due today: pre-arrival messages and preventive maintenance tickets (the scheduler does this daily too)

get.summary: Exchange rates entered for a date (default: the business date)

put.summary: Enter the day's rates: hotel currency per 1 unit of each foreign currency (no FX provider)

get.summary: A folio's balance shown in another currency at the business date's rate

post.summary: Record a payment in a foreign currency, converted at the business date's rate (recorded, not processed; cash needs your shift)
Comp or discount a charge (all or part of its net, with its taxes). Posts at once; someone else approves it; the income audit lists it.
Approve a comp or discount made by someone else
Issue the tax invoice of a settled folio (company invoice for a company folio) with the next sequential number

get.summary: Invoices and credit notes of a hotel
One invoice or credit note (an issued document never changes)

post.summary: Cancel an invoice document with a credit note (someone other than its issuer), so the folio can be invoiced again. Money corrections are voids, allowances and refunds.
Record the invoice e-mail to the buyer in the outbox (recorded, not sent — no e-mail provider connected)
Submit to the tax authority's e-invoicing system (BLOCKED: test adapter until a certified one exists)

get.summary: Collection actions on a company account

post.summary: Record a collection action (reminder, call, promise to pay, note) or send a statement (recorded in the outbox, not sent)

get.summary: Company accounts with overdue balances (past their payment terms) and the next action due

post.summary: Import bank statement lines (from the hotel's bank export). Lines with the same amount and reference as a recorded payment are matched at once.

get.summary: Imported bank lines and what each is matched to
Payments recorded at the hotel (folio payments, deposits, company payments, event deposits, tips)

post.summary: Match a bank line to recorded payments: the payments less the card / provider fee must equal the line. The fee posts bank charges 5300 / bank 1000.
A negative bank line that reverses a guest's card payment: the money is owed again (receivables 1100 / bank 1000)

get.summary: Recorded payments vs the bank for a period: matched, unmatched, fees and chargebacks, by method
An outlet's menu with modifiers, recipes and food cost

post.summary: Add or change a menu item by its code (price, category, modifiers, on sale or not)

put.summary: Replace a menu item's recipe: stock used per portion (deducted from stock on every sale)
Seats and table time of a restaurant (table bookings are refused beyond the seats)

post.summary: Open an order at a table; it goes to the kitchen screen at once (outlet staff: their own outlet only)

get.summary: An outlet's orders

post.summary: Add items to an open order (a new kitchen ticket for them)

Settle an order: charge it to an in-house guest's room (refused if their folio is blocked) or record payment now — split across several payments if needed. Stock is deducted by recipe; cost of sales posts.
Cancel an open order (nothing was charged); its kitchen tickets are cancelled

get.summary: The kitchen screen: tickets by status (kitchen printers: test adapter — on-screen only)

post.summary: Move a kitchen ticket on: preparing → ready → served

get.summary: Restaurant bookings for a day (or every outlet)

post.summary: Book a table for a guest, a website visitor or an in-house guest (by room). Refused when the restaurant's seats are taken for that time.
Seat, complete, cancel or mark a table booking as a no-show

get.summary: Stock on hand with par levels and reorder alerts; the value equals inventory account 1300

post.summary: Add a stock item (food, beverage, linen, amenity, cleaning) with its par level
Receive stock bought without a purchase order (market purchase): inventory 1300 / bank 1000 or payables 2000
Issue stock for use (linen and amenities to rooms, food to a kitchen) or write off waste, at average cost: F&B cost of sales 5200 or rooms costs 5100 / inventory 1300
Record a stock count; each variance posts at average cost (shortage expensed, surplus credited)

get.summary: Every movement of one stock item
Purchase orders with receipts and supplier bills

post.summary: Raise a purchase order for stock (e.g. the items below par); someone else approves it
Approve a purchase order raised by someone else
Receive goods against an approved order (part or all): inventory 1300 / goods received not invoiced 2010
Enter the supplier's bill. Three-way match: when it equals the goods received and not yet billed (at order prices) it posts GRNI 2010 + VAT 2100 / payables 2000; otherwise it is held for approval.
Approve a held bill (someone other than who entered it): the price variance posts to cost of sales or rooms costs

get.summary: Treatments and activities, therapists / guides and treatment rooms

post.summary: Add a treatment (one guest) or an activity (a group up to its capacity), priced per participant
Add a therapist, guide or instructor
Add a treatment room, studio or piece of equipment that bookings take

get.summary: Treatment and activity bookings for a day

post.summary: Book a treatment or activity with a therapist / guide and room at a time. A therapist or room is never double-booked; an activity session holds up to its capacity.
Treatment given: charge it to the guest's room (in house, folio not blocked) or record payment now
Cancel a booking or mark it a no-show; the therapist and room are free again

get.summary: Meeting and event spaces

post.summary: Add a meeting or event space with its capacity
Quote an event: venue, times, guests, setup and the event order (menus, AV, room hire)

get.summary: Events between two dates
One event with its order lines and deposits

put.summary: Replace the event order lines; after the contract each change issues a new function sheet version

post.summary: Record the signed contract (document reference; e-signature not connected). The venue is then held — never double-booked.
Record a deposit on a contracted event (recorded, not processed): bank 1000 / deposits 2350
Final bill: every order line charged by department with taxes, deposits applied, and a company event sent to the city ledger (within its credit limit)
Cancel an event that holds no deposit (with a deposit: bill a cancellation charge instead)

get.summary: The banquet event order / function sheet: venue, setup, timings, menus, AV and notes, with its version
The function diary: every venue's events per day (group sales and events)
The hotel's staff register with pay (payroll officer only — salaries are hidden from every other role)

post.summary: Add or change a staff member's pay basis, department and service-charge points

get.summary: Pay runs (department totals; individual lines only for the payroll officer)

post.summary: Prepare a month's pay run from the inputs: salary, hours (from the staff schedule unless given), overtime at the hotel's multiplier, allowances
Approve a pay run prepared by someone else: departmental payroll 51x0–5950 / wages payable 2200
Share the tips pool (2130) or the service charge collected (2120) up to a date among active staff by their points: posts the pool to wages payable 2200

get.summary: Tips and service-charge distributions (shares only for the payroll officer)

put.summary: Labour standards: minutes per occupied room, per restaurant cover, per event guest, or fixed per day

get.summary: Staff names and departments for scheduling (no pay)

post.summary: Schedule shifts (a shift may end after midnight); one person never has two overlapping shifts

get.summary: Scheduled shifts between two dates
Staff hours needed per department and day from occupancy on the books, table covers and event guests, against the schedule; labour cost per occupied room from the ledger

put.summary: Set a month's budget (or reforecast) by department: rooms sold, revenue and costs

get.summary: Budgets and reforecasts of a year
Daily manager's report: the day, month to date and year to date — actual (from the ledger) vs budget (pro rata) and last year — and the month's forecast from bookings on the books
Fixed assets with depreciation to date and net book value

post.summary: Add a fixed asset bought today: fixed assets 1500 / bank, payables or the FF&E reserve fund (straight-line depreciation)
Post a month's straight-line depreciation once (depreciation 6100 / accumulated depreciation 1590)
Dispose of an asset: cost and depreciation removed, proceeds to the bank, the gain or loss posted

get.summary: The FF&E replacement reserve: rate, contributions, spending on assets and the fund balance (ledger 1020)

post.summary: Put a month's share of total revenue (from the ledger) into the FF&E reserve fund, once per month

get.summary: Occupancy forecast from bookings on the books, pickup in the last 7 days, pace vs the same lead time last year, and a rules-based rate suggestion
Pickup: room nights booked and cancelled in a booking window, by stay date
Rules-based BAR suggestions per room type and night from the forecast and pace (no external AI)

post.summary: Apply a suggestion: the BAR price of that room type and night changes (a one-night season) and goes to every channel
Group displacement: transient room revenue the group would push out (forecast demand at BAR) vs the group's room revenue

get.summary: Corporate RFPs (negotiated rates by account and season)

post.summary: Record a company's RFP: rates per room type for a season and the room nights it expects
Accept (creates the company's corporate rate plan with the RFP rates for the season) or decline an RFP

get.summary: Production per company and travel agent: reservations, room nights, room revenue and ADR
Revenue by outlet (from folio lines) and F&B cost % by outlet (stock used by recipe, from the ledger)
Housekeeping productivity per attendant and out-of-order room nights
Energy, water, waste and carbon per occupied room from meter readings the hotel records; linen-reuse opt-ins and eco-mode commands

post.summary: Record daily meter readings (energy kWh, water m³, waste kg) — entered by staff until sensors are connected

get.summary: Arrivals with what the hotel knows: preferences, allergies (with consent), VIP, past stays and spend, loyalty tier, last score and offers matched to past stays (rules)
Today's cleaning order (rules, no AI): rooms for today's arrivals first, then check-outs, then stay-overs, by floor; linen changes due

post.summary: An attendant finishes their room with the checklist; damage reported with a photo reference opens a maintenance ticket

get.summary: Preventive maintenance schedules (AC, boilers, lifts, pool …)

post.summary: Add a recurring preventive job; a ticket opens on each due date (the scheduler and automation run raise it)

get.summary: Ready to serve: the database answers and every migration is applied (503 otherwise). /health checks the process and the database only.
